_about: Place strings decided by hand, each with its reason. 'places' is keyed by the string as printed; 'by_ground_town' by the town that data/era/ground.tsv names in its reason column for a string it left without a point; 'exclude' lists strings that must stay unplaced. A 'gazetteer' decision names the Record Atlas's GeoNames gazetteer (read only) and must match exactly one place, or the builder stops. The Atlas is never written to; a place it lacks is reported in tree.report.json, not added.

Bermondsey.why: the English line's birthplace (St Olave, Bermondsey): the only Bermondsey in the gazetteer

Southwark.why: the English line's «St Olave Southwark» (a registration district): the only Southwark in the gazetteer

Hitchin.why: the English line's Hitchin (the registration district and town): the only Hitchin in the gazetteer

Weston, Hertfordshire.why: the string names Hertfordshire; of the 21 Westons in Great Britain the one within 15 km of Hitchin is the Hertfordshire village

Wallington, Hertfordshire.why: the string names Hertfordshire; of the five Wallingtons in Great Britain the one within 15 km of Hitchin is the Hertfordshire village

Schlochau, Pomerania.why: Schlochau is the German name of Człuchów, Pomerania (now Poland); the one Człuchów in the gazetteer

Hammerstein (Czarne), Pomerania, Germany.why: the string names Czarne; of the twelve Czarnes in Poland only one has over 5,000 people (Czarne, the former Hammerstein)

Hammerstein, Westpreußen, Germany now Po.why: Hammerstein is Czarne (Poland); of the twelve Czarnes in Poland only one has over 5,000 people

Auschwitz.why: Auschwitz is the German name of Oświęcim; the camp stood there; the one Oświęcim of over 10,000 people in Poland

KZ Auschwitz, Oświęcim County, Lesser Po.why: the string names Oświęcim County, Poland

Theresienstadt.why: Theresienstadt is the German name of Terezín (the ghetto was the town); the one Terezín of over 2,000 people in Czechia

Kulmhof (Chelmno), Vernichtungslager.why: Kulmhof is Chełmno nad Nerem, where the extermination camp stood (not Chełmno on the Vistula); the one in the gazetteer

KZ Kulmhof | Chełmno, Kuyavian-Pomerania.why: as Kulmhof: the camp stood at Chełmno nad Nerem; the string's «Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship» is where Chełmno on the Vistula is, so the string is not taken at its word

Berlin.why: data/era/ground.tsv decides this string is Berlin (the capital) or one of its districts; drawn at the Atlas's Berlin

Berlin-Kreuzberg.why: ground.tsv: Kreuzberg, a district of Berlin; drawn at the Atlas's Berlin

Berlin-Neukolln.why: ground.tsv: Neukölln, a district of Berlin; drawn at the Atlas's Berlin

Potsdam.why: ground.tsv: Potsdam, Brandenburg (the only Potsdam in Germany in the gazetteer)

Stahnsdorf.why: ground.tsv: Stahnsdorf, Brandenburg (the only one in Germany)

Kleinmachnow.why: ground.tsv: Kleinmachnow, Brandenburg (the only one in Germany)

Teltow.why: ground.tsv: Teltow, Brandenburg (the only one in Germany)

Ludwigsfelde.why: ground.tsv: Ludwigsfelde, Brandenburg (the only one in Germany)

Mahlow.why: ground.tsv: Mahlow, Kreis Zossen, Brandenburg (the only one in Germany)

Kraichtal.why: ground.tsv: Kraichtal, Baden-Württemberg (the only one in Germany)

Zeutern.why: ground.tsv: Zeutern, near Bruchsal, Baden-Württemberg (the only one in Germany)

Bad Worishofen.why: ground.tsv: Bad Wörishofen, Bavaria (the only one in Germany)

Geretsried.why: ground.tsv: Geretsried, Bavaria (the only one in Germany)

Magdeburg.why: ground.tsv: Magdeburg (Buckau is a district of it); the only Magdeburg in Germany

Munich.why: ground.tsv: Munich (München); the one Munich in Germany of over a million people

Melbourne.why: ground.tsv: Melbourne, or one of its suburbs (South Yarra, Toorak); drawn at the Atlas's Melbourne

Hamm.why: the string says Hamm, Arnsberg, NRW; of the twelve places called Hamm in Germany only one has over 100,000 people (Hamm, Westphalia)

Sommerfeld, Osthavelland.why: the string says Osthavelland; of the three Sommerfelds in Germany the one near Kremmen is in the old Kreis Osthavelland (the others are in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Saxony)

Kutten, Saxony-Anhalt.why: ground.tsv: Kütten, Kreis Bitterfeld, Saxony-Anhalt (the only one in Germany)

Lourenco Marques, Mozambique.why: Lourenço Marques is the former name of Maputo, as the string says Mozambique; drawn at Maputo

exclude.Eisenbahnstrasse 82Eberswalde, Berlin: the address is in Eberswalde, not Berlin; the archive's ground.tsv reason says Berlin, which the string does not support
